text:
anita: quick heads-up — during yesterday's EU capacity bump we saw ~10 tenant route flaps in 30m. tracing points at lease refresh storms from edge proxies, not KV corruption. wondering if we should try a probe-on-extend pattern instead of frequent heartbeats to reduce spurious failovers
liam: paste the log snippet you saw?
anita: ```
2026-03-20T22:11:03Z proxy-123 refresh lease tenant=acme-r EU err=timeout
2026-03-20T22:11:03Z proxy-123 fallback route tenant=acme-r -> region=us-west
2026-03-20T22:11:07Z proxy-123 refresh lease retry tenant=acme-r ok ttl=12s
2026-03-20T22:11:10Z proxy-123 refresh lease tenant=acme-r err=deadline_exceeded
```
sam: probe-on-extend? explain the difference quickly
anita: short: instead of sending periodic renew heartbeats every Xs, proxy will only attempt a cheap TCP/HTTP probe to the local lease owner when it's about to give up. if probe succeeds, we extend local short-term route without flipping owner. if probe fails, we escalate to full lease reacquire/failover. idea is to avoid full ownership swap caused by transient network hiccups
maria: legal guardrail: careful not to confuse routing leases with data residency TTLs. we cannot let data leave region longer than residency policy. probe-on-extend should only affect routing decision, not data placement. confirm?
anita: confirmed — KV ownership & residency TTL unchanged. probes only gate the routing lease *extension*. no cross-region writes.
liam: curious about perf tradeoffs — extra probe adds RTT before extension, could it hurt p99 for live requests?
anita: ran a small sim on staging with 200 tenants: p50 +2ms, p95 +5ms, p99 +8-12ms under heavy contention. but failover events dropped from ~7/hr to 0-1/hr for the noisy tenants, so overall user-visible errors down
sam: how do we roll this safely? feature flag per-proxy? per-region? per-tenant?
anita: propose gradual: 1) implement flag gated behind config: probe_mode=off|staging|canary|on 2) enable staging in eu-west cluster 3) canary -> 10% tenant slice for 6h 4) monitor failover_count, route_stability, p99 latency 5) if good -> 100%
maria: add observability: lease_events{result=probe_ok|probe_fail|heartbeat_ok|reacquire}, tenant.failover_count, and a tag lease_method=probe|heartbeat in traces. also add audit log entry when probe prevented failover for legal review
liam: i'll open a routing-service PR and a console flag UI change. putting wip branch: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/compare/probe-extend-experiment
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: canary job queued for eu-west-staging (job id: cj-4821). will notify on completion.
anita: i'll draft a short runbook snippet for operator on how to toggle probe_mode and how to force immediate reacquire if needed. also include chaos test (drop 25% control plane packets for 2m)
sam: schedule a 2h window tomorrow to run chaos and observe metrics, i'll own dashboard + alert thresholds
maria: lgtm if we keep strict separation from data residency. please include that in PR description and the audit log change
liam: noted — PR will contain links to the sim perf results, the flag config, and the observability changes
anita: thanks team — next steps: liam PR, ops will run canary after deploy-bot, sam runs chaos, maria verifies audit hooks. :thumbsup:
